name: mcp-open-tender-rfp-finder
description: MCP server for Open Tender and RFP Finder. Find open public tenders and RFPs by keyword, CPV code, and country from UK Contracts Finder, UK Find a Tender, EU TED, and CanadaBuys: one row per notice with buyer, deadline, value, codes, and link. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
